organizations.normalization_notes: The historical Norwegian name printed by Store norske leksikon is preserved. No owner, legal form, or successor organization is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: Store norske leksikon places the factory employment after Haugland's 1940 demobilization and before he went into hiding, fled Norway, and entered Kompani Linge in 1941; exact employment dates are not stated.
affiliations.research_notes: This is the last documented civilian employer before Haugland resumed clandestine Allied wartime service. It is not labeled an immediate pre-OSS affiliation because the reviewed sources establish British SOE and Kompani Linge service, not a direct OSS assignment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed First Lieutenant Knut Haugland is the Norwegian officer and resistance radio specialist Knut Magne Haugland.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact distinctive indexed name and officer rank align with two authoritative Norwegian accounts of Knut Magne Haugland's wartime military and special-operations service; neither reviewed account establishes a direct OSS assignment.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, indexed officer rank, and independent scholarly and institutional accounts identifying him as a Norwegian wartime officer and radio specialist.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources document his 1940-1945 chronology, but the Box 319 personnel file remains necessary to explain why a British-SOE-linked Norwegian officer appears in the OSS index.
claims.match_notes: Do not translate index inclusion into a claim of direct OSS service. The reviewed sources establish British SOE, Kompani Linge, Norwegian resistance, and Norwegian military service; the exact NARA file relationship remains unresolved.

claims.claim_text: Høvding Radiofabrikk in Oslo is Knut Haugland's last documented civilian employer before he resumed clandestine Allied wartime service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Etter demobiliseringen arbeidet han på Høvding Radiofabrikk i Oslo.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Norwegian scholarly biography places Haugland at the Oslo radio factory after demobilization, then describes his 1941 flight to Britain and admission to Kompani Linge.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, officer rank, and corroborating institutional wartime biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded: employment falls between 1940 demobilization and the 1941 transition to clandestine Allied service, although exact start and end dates are not supplied.
claims.match_notes: The claim is limited to the last documented civilian employer before resumed wartime service. It does not characterize Høvding Radiofabrikk as an OSS predecessor or establish a direct OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The distinctive exact indexed name and First Lieutenant rank are corroborated by a Norwegian scholarly biography and the Kon-Tiki Museum's Haugland archive description. Both identify Knut Magne Haugland as a Norwegian wartime officer and radio specialist. Neither source establishes a direct OSS assignment, so index inclusion is not described as OSS service.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 319 to establish the precise relationship between Haugland, the OSS personnel index, British SOE, and Kompani Linge, and to confirm the indexed First Lieutenant rank date.

research_attempts.query_text: Knut Haugland Norwegian officer resistance employment Høvding Radiofabrikk SOE Kompani Linge biography archive
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Wikipedia was discovery-only; newspaper obituaries were unnecessary once scholarly and institutional Norwegian sources supplied the chronology; derivative history pages did not clarify the NARA-index relationship.
research_attempts.research_notes: The research establishes a high-confidence identity, corrects the U.S.-Army-style automated category to foreign or Allied military personnel, and documents Høvding Radiofabrikk as the last civilian employer before resumed wartime service. It deliberately does not claim direct OSS service.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 319 for the exact OSS-index relationship, service chronology, and any direct recruitment or liaison documentation.
